name: Doki Doki Blue Skies
source:
A psychological, choice-heavy take on the world of [url=/v21905]Doki Doki Literature Club![/url] with added characters, art, music, poetry and writing, heavily inspired by [url=/v945]Katawa Shoujo[/url].

Will blue skies remain, or will the storm take over?

[Edited from the [url=https://blueskiesmod.club/]official website[/url]]
translation:
本作以心理描写与大量选择为特色，重新演绎[url=/v21905]《心跳文学部！》[/url]的世界，加入了新角色、插画、音乐、诗歌与剧情，并深受[url=/v945]《片轮少女》[/url]的启发。

蓝天能否依旧，还是风暴终将席卷一切？

[编译自[url=https://blueskiesmod.club/]官方网站[/url]]
